title: December, 2000
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Does Chloe come home. The strip goes to the bus stop. Watches two buses. Draws the second.

panels.composition: The Greyhound stop on 101, December, rain. WOOD on the bench with BARNABY. The 4:10 arriving.

image.prompt: a young man and a small dog at a roadside Greyhound stop in December rain as a bus pulls in, brush-pen black and white

panels.composition: The door opens. Two people get off. Neither is her. The door closes.

image.prompt: a bus door open at a roadside stop with two strangers stepping down, no one else

panels.composition: The 6:40, dark now. Door open. One person. A man with a duffel. Door closes.

image.prompt: the same roadside stop after dark with a second bus, one man with a duffel bag stepping down, a young man and a dog still on the bench

panels.composition: Wood drawing the second bus pulling away. Taillights. The dog asleep on his foot. He draws the taillights very carefully.

image.prompt: a young man on a roadside bench at night carefully drawing a bus's departing taillights while a small dog sleeps on his foot, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen over rough blue pencil; xerox grain; stark spotting; rain in frantic vertical hatching (Arc 1's aesthetic)

notes: She does not come home. Two buses. He draws the one that leaves.
